Now, I received a direct deposit of a settlement that's supposed to be ours. I haven't told him about it, and I don't plan to. I'm wondering if this is the right thing to do or if it's wrong. First, I need to think about why I'm keeping this money a secret. Is it because I don't trust him with the money? Or is it because I feel like he's not contributing equally to our finances? Maybe I feel like he's not pulling his weight when it comes to our financial responsibilities, so I'm taking matters into my own hands. On the other hand, keeping this money from him might be causing trust issues in our relationship. If we're supposed to be a team, financially and otherwise, keeping things from each other can create problems down the line. It might lead to arguments or misunderstandings. I also need to consider the legal aspect. Is the settlement money ours jointly, or is it mine individually? If it's supposed to be ours, then keeping it from him might not be legally sound. But if it's mine individually, then maybe I have the right to keep it without his knowledge. Another thing to think about is how this affects our financial planning. If I'm keeping this money, am I using it wisely? Or am I just holding onto it because of the way our transfers work? Maybe I should look into a better way to manage our finances together, so we're both on the same page. I also wonder if there's a way to communicate with him about this without making him feel attacked or defensive. Maybe we can sit down and talk about our financial situation openly and find a solution that works for both of us. In the end, I need to decide whether keeping this money without telling him is the right decision. It might seem like the easy way out, but it could lead to bigger problems later on. Maybe it's better to address the issue head-on and work together to find a fair solution.
